decisions.reason: As a sustainability-led agriculture product that was launched as a flagship, it still fits the firm's direction, though its narrow citrus focus and lack of later website visibility create some portfolio-review risk.
The foldable large container line sits squarely in the firm's core reusable transport-packaging business and is likely to stay as a broadly applicable product family.
A medium-duty rackable pallet is close to the firm's established pallet business, so it remains more valuable as part of a full range than as a candidate for withdrawal.
The spill-retention pallet line is more specialized and therefore somewhat more exposed to rationalization, but it still leverages the firm's pallet expertise and serves a useful niche.

This pallet with load retainers is a niche extension of the core pallet portfolio and is likely to be retained because it adds customer-specific functionality without straying from the firm's strengths.
